how_to_apply: Visit the official Institute website, www.dei.ac.in.
Locate the online application link for Advertisement No. 09 DEI - JULY 2026 and register/submit the application form with the required details.
On successful submission, use the link provided to pay the application registration fee online.
After payment, download the PDF of the submitted application.

Keep original documents ready - a separate set of the application form, fee receipt, self-attested annexures (certificates and mark-sheets from matriculation onward supporting qualification, caste, and experience), and two passport-size photographs - for production at the time of the Seminar-cum-Presentation/Aptitude Test/Interview.

Employed candidates should route their application through proper channel or attach a No Objection Certificate from their current employer. Any addendum or corrigendum will be published only on www.dei.ac.in, so candidates should check the website regularly.

content_sections.heading: DEI Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility is post-specific. Teaching post qualifications are governed by the UGC Regulations, 2018 (and subsequent amendments) or NCTE/AICTE norms, as applicable. Key common conditions: Applicants must be Indian nationals (including Persons of Indian Origin) or Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs). A minimum of 55% marks (or an equivalent grade) at the master's level is the essential qualification for direct recruitment of teachers and equivalent cadres at any level. A 5% relaxation at Bachelor's and Master's level is allowed for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and specified categories of Persons with Disabilities, based on qualifying marks only (no grace marks). NET/SLET/SET remains the minimum eligibility for Assistant Professor and equivalent posts wherever prescribed under UGC Regulations 2018, except for candidates who hold a Ph.D. awarded under specified UGC Ph.D. Regulations and who satisfy the listed conditions (regular-mode Ph.D., evaluation by two external examiners, open viva-voce, two research papers with at least one in a refereed journal, and two conference presentations). Teaching posts in DEI P.V. Girls' Intermediate College are open only to female candidates. Teaching and non-teaching posts in DEI R.E.I. Intermediate College, and non-teaching posts in DEI Technical College, are open only to male candidates. Employed applicants must apply through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer before the Seminar-cum-Presentation/Aptitude Test/Trade Test/Interview. Age Limit: The notification does not prescribe a general upper age limit for most posts. The only age-related condition specified is for the Principal post at DEI R.E.I. Intermediate College, where the candidate should not be below 30 years under one of the eligibility routes. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.
